summary: An earlier Molde tower, numbered 103 on a 1939 list, moved to Lake of the Woods County in 1958; removed, and no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Agency field was corrected from a township-range-section location (see corrections). Height 81 ft from both county and state lists, added as 24.7 m; the list height may not be measured to the cab floor. No build year, staffing, fire history or removal date found. The 1939 list entry is the earliest reference. The Central US Lookouts page is a one-word status; the story does not claim more.
